answer: Require each agent to lock a deposit before it can trade, and let peers slash that deposit when cheating is proven. An honest agent pays once and keeps working. An attacker who wants a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand deposits, and one proven cheat burns each stake, so the attack gets expensive fast. The same rule covers very different work, whether an agent plots a comet path, surveys a reef, or guides a falcon tracking drone, and good behavior earns the money back.
